name: dropped-module-scripts
description: A module dropped because it does not load keeps its module-not-loaded note, and each of its scripts is a program run by naming the file: a file other than a test file declaring package main and a function main in a directory where another such file declares main too, which no build of its package compiles. Each declaration of the target a script names is a root, its names resolving as they do when the toolchain builds that file alone.
